text:
raj: Heads up — CI produced RC: rc-2026-03-22-db. Includes small schema change (nullable col added). Need migration window & pin strategy. tagging @claire @lina @oncall-sre @deploybot

claire: Reviewing notes now. Where are the migration scripts? Is this additive-only?

lina: Migration is additive only (`add_column responses.metadata JSONB NULL`). Script in infra/migrations/20260322_add_metadata.sql and migration-runner supports backout flag. No destructive changes. Will need a 10m db lock at apply time.

raj: Proposed deployment plan: blue/green with DB migration on the green side before switching traffic. Migration window in the change calendar is 2026-03-22 22:00-23:00 UTC. Can we do canary 3-step: 2% -> 20% -> 100% with health gates?

oncall-sre: I can take watch. Gates: 5m error rate < 0.4%, p95 < 250ms, DB replication lag < 50ms. If replication lag > 200ms or any schema error -> immediate rollback and promote old green.

productops: Confirming calendar window reserved. Add runbook link to incident channel before promote.

claire: QA signoff pending one regression test for streaming responses. I can greenlight after a staging run (10m).

lina: Staging run passed. Also added a feature-flag gated migration: `rc_db_metadata` default OFF. We'll flip it only after green is ready. Migration can be toggled with `migration-runner --apply --tag rc-2026-03-22`.

raj: Good. Governance: need PM + QA + SRE ack. If all OK I'll queue the promote with pin. Pin artifact so rollback can point to stable tag. Proposed command:

/deploy promote --artifact rc-2026-03-22-db --strategy blue-green --pin stable=rc-2026-03-22-db --canary 2% --region global --notes "RC with additive metadata column"

deploybot: Promote request queued (id: promote-7390023456-A). To cancel: `/deploy abort promote-7390023456-A`.

productops: :thumbsup: PM ack (noted migration window).

oncall-sre: SRE ack, I'll watch the DB metrics and app latency.

claire: QA ack. Streaming regression looks fine.

deploybot: Promotion started. Logs:
[00:00:10] pulling artifact rc-2026-03-22-db
[00:00:25] provisioning green cluster (scaled to match blue)
[00:01:20] deploying services to green
[00:02:05] running DB migration (dry-run) -> OK

raj: Running migration apply now on green: `migration-runner --apply --tag rc-2026-03-22`. This will take ~2m and holds a short exclusive lock.

lina: Migration applied on green. No errors. Replication lag nominal.

oncall-sre: Green metrics look good for 5m. Starting canary ingress 2% -> traffic routed to green for a rolling 15m window.

deploybot: Canary ingress configured (2%).

oncall-sre: 6m in, seeing a small spike in write latency (db p99 up to 420ms) — watching. If it remains >400ms for 2 more minutes we will abort.

claire: Logs show a couple of heavy joins from a backfill job — not from this RC.

oncall-sre: Spike subsided. p99 back < 220ms. continuing.

raj: Proceed to 20% per plan: `/deploy promote --id promote-7390023456-A --step 2 --canary 20%`

deploybot: Canary ramp to 20% started.

oncall-sre: At 20% steady, no errors. DB replication lag 12ms.

raj: Proceed to cutover. We'll switch traffic 100% to green and flip ff `rc_db_metadata` -> ON for traffic routing. Final command: `/deploy promote --complete promote-7390023456-A --to 100% --flip-flag rc_db_metadata=true`

deploybot: Finalizing promotion...

deploybot: Promotion complete. Blue deprecated but kept pinned as `stable:rc-2026-03-15` for quick rollback. Post-deploy sanity checks: smoke OK, traces look normal.

claire: Quick note: observed one error 500 from a deserialization path on a legacy client (edge case). Pushed hotfix PR #489 to handle missing metadata key gracefully. Can we hotpatch or roll?

raj: Let's avoid full rollback. Hotpatch flow: pin a small patch to the running green and redeploy (hotfix). If fix is trivial, we can promote patch within the same window. Do we have a patch artifact?

claire: Patch artifact built: rc-2026-03-22-db-hotfix. CI smoke OK.

raj: OK queue hotfix promote with zero-downtime rollout, no migration. `/deploy promote --artifact rc-2026-03-22-db-hotfix --strategy rolling --regions all --notes "hotfix: handle missing metadata"`

deploybot: Hotfix promote queued (id: promote-7390023456-B).

oncall-sre: I'll watch but not escalate unless error rate rises.

deploybot: Hotfix promotion complete. Error 500 count dropped to zero in the next 2m.

productops: Updating release notes: https://docs.redwood/releases/2026-03-22-db (added hotfix note).

raj: Closing thread — RC promoted, migration applied on green, hotfix applied. Keeping an eye for 1h then handing back to normal ops. If rollback needed use:

/deploy rollback --to pinned=stable:rc-2026-03-15 --reason "major regressions" --incident-id <INC>

claire: Thanks everyone. Good run. :party_parrot:
